description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractRule' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for endpoint rules management in the AWS EndpointV2 library. It includes properties for conditions and documentation, and methods to evaluate conditions and retrieve stored data.

classes.name: AbstractRule
classes.description: An abstract class representing a rule within a rule set for endpoint selection, containing condition evaluation logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with a set of conditions and optional documentation.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the array of conditions associated with the rule.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Returns the documentation associated with the rule, if any.

methods.name: evaluateConditions
methods.description: Evaluates all conditions for the rule using the provided input parameters and standard library.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate the rule given input parameters and a standard library; must be implemented by subclasses.
